title_vi: Quy trình: tái chế chai thủy tinh
prompt: The diagram below shows how used glass bottles are recycled into new bottles. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visuals.title: Recycling glass bottles
steps: Used bottles are collected from recycling bins
Bottles are taken by truck to a sorting plant
Glass is sorted by colour and washed
Glass is crushed into small pieces called cullet
Cullet is melted in a furnace at 1,500°C
Molten glass is shaped into new bottles in moulds
New bottles are filled and delivered to shops

title_vi: Quy trình: sản xuất trà
prompt: The diagram below shows the stages in the production of tea, from the plantation to the shop. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visuals.title: Producing tea
steps: Young leaves are picked by hand
Leaves are spread out to wither in warm air for 12–18 hours
Leaves are rolled to break them and release their juices
Leaves are left to oxidise and turn dark
Leaves are dried in hot ovens
Dried tea is sorted by size and graded
Tea is packed and sent to shops
